title: Tax quantity vocabulary, covered-long-term-gain proceeds/basis added
description: Immutable, versioned closed vocabulary for quantity identities used by residual-closed source amount fact types (ADR-0028 decision 7). v4 adds covered-ltcg-proceeds and covered-ltcg-basis for the twin scalar collectible companions ADR-0054 introduces for the covered-long-term-gain eligible transaction. v1, v2, and v3 remain immutable history.
